environment_note: Recorded because it nearly caused a false FAIL on this PR and is independent of the reminder. The first baseline run of check-readme-imports.test.mjs reported 89 passed / 4 FAILED, against the PR's claimed 93/0. All four failures were one cluster — the positive control expecting exit 0 and getting exit 2. Root cause was MY environment, not the PR: `npm` is unresolvable from this harness shell because its `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang cannot find `node` on the child PATH, so buildCleanRoom could not pack and the guard correctly returned CANNOT CHECK. Re-running with PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:... gave 93 passed / 0 failed, matching the PR exactly. Two things worth keeping: the guard's cannot-check discipline behaved perfectly under a genuinely broken environment, refusing to report a pass it could not establish; and this is a live instance of the 'npm cannot start' site that issue #674 describes as intermittently unrunnable.
